keyMessages: Above normal temperatures will continue through Tuesday with highs generally in the 90s.
There will be periodic chances for showers and thunderstorms through Sunday night.
An isolated severe weather threat will exist with any storms during the late afternoon and evening hours today and tomorrow. Hail and damaging winds will be the main hazards.
Confidence continues to increase in a wetter pattern beginning mid next week continuing into next weekend.
